changes.summary: Version 2.0.0: 2,942 records for 2024: 42 states and DC with nonfatal injury rates, the 50 states and DC with fatal work injury counts. The column note is now detail. 7 columns (such as rate and count2023) are now in work-injuries-values.csv, as id, column and value rows; join it to work-injuries.csv on id.
3512 records for 2024: 43 states with nonfatal injury rates, 51 with fatal work injury counts.
